responsibility: This header defines rtx_vector_builder, the RTL specialization of GCC’s generic vector_builder framework for constructing CONST_VECTOR constants. It supplies mode- and RTX-specific equality, integer-step, and pattern-shape hooks, tracks the target machine_mode being built, and exposes build/new_vector operations for creating encoded vector constants with repeated or stepped element patterns.
same_name_distinction: Defines the rtx_vector_builder class as the RTL-specific specialization of generic vector_builder, declaring its mode/step/equality hooks and build interface; rtx-vector-builder.cc supplies the concrete construction routines.
